== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)|I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V)]] (31 May 2023, [[:File:V21-L-icantbelievehesgone-PC-E1.png|V21-L-icantbelievehesgone-PC-E1.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (page 6). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
